## SUNDAY EXIT-MANAGEMENT PICKS (order 1515Z/Saturday 16:00Z; sets sun*, variant M = inside the live mix with Trade Health and live layers vs the live mix as run). One row per book and side: the best FINISHED setting by the standing rule (prior-year filter PY first, then max DD and worst week vs live, then L6M income); PASS-W = W-SUNDAY rule (max DD and worst week not worse than live, L6M DD not deeper, income >= 97% of live, DD shallower in >= 7 of 12 13-week periods, prior-year filter) else WEAK; PASS-H = harness rule (beats live on DD and worst week with income within 10%, or more income with DD not deeper; L3M and L6M not worse; random-management null not applicable to a fixed setting). JOINT rows appear when joint sets (side J) are registered; until then the profit pick and the loss pick are shown separately and are NOT a tested pair. All 896+ sets are listed in autopilot/SUNDAY_SETS_ALL.md. Sets are read as soon as 42 months are DONE; unfinished sets only show progress.
